Sample Cameras Group Inc.
Order Form and Implementation Plan
Customer: Example Community Association

Sample Cameras will provide license plate reader cameras and the hosted software for a term of twenty-four (24) months.
Sample Cameras Group Inc. may update these terms at any time by posting the updated terms on its website.

Implementation Steps
Step 1 Conduct On-site Survey & Place Flags
SAMPLE CAMERAS:
Your sales representative will present several viable options for camera locations.
When the technician deems the locations suitable, the technician will place a white flag at each spot.
CUSTOMER:
Prepare the items below, as needed.
If permits are required, begin the application process.
If a camera will be AC-powered, hire an electrician.
Step 2 Installation
SAMPLE CAMERAS:
Sample Cameras will coordinate with the utility locating service to mark each camera location for underground utilities within a 10-foot radius.
Sample Cameras will install each camera within thirty (30) days after the permits are issued.
CUSTOMER:
Provide access to each location on the scheduled installation day.
Step 3 Training
SAMPLE CAMERAS:
Sample Cameras will give you full access to the system along with training resources.

Fees: Professional Services - Standard Implementation Fee $350.00 One-time Professional Services engagement.
Annual subscription $2,500.00 per camera.
